reading.body:
Google does not publish power capacity, square footage, or exact addresses for individual buildings at its Clarksville-Montgomery County data center campus, including SPC3A. The regional investment figure for the campus is approximately $600 million, reported by DataCenterDynamics and ClarksvilleNow at the time of Google's official opening, but this translates to no disclosed wattage for this specific building.

Tennessee has 24 mapped data center facilities. Only four facilities in the state have published power figures from operator spec pages, totaling 12.13 MW. SPC3A ranks fifth in the state by published capacity, which means it has no published figure and is ranked behind the four facilities with disclosed specs.

Without published power capacity for this building, its relevance to AI scaling cannot be assessed from available data. Google's disclosure policy treats individual facility specifications as confidential, making this site's ability to measure the campus's contribution to state or regional AI infrastructure dependent on future operator transparency or independent verification methods.
